mechanism_narrative: A high level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% indicates a tightening labor market that enhances consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by > 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS declining), accommodative policy reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles (as defined by FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery phase (HOUST rising above 1300 thousand units), housing market strength drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during post-recession recovery (HOUST > 1300), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 315 (index 1982-1984=100) indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers expectations of monetary tightening and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 315, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
